title: MapleStory M Equipment Refinement Guide
author: MapleStory M GM
summary: Official Refinement guidance covering Empress, Longinus, and Genesis refinement, eligible base equipment, material sources, inherited attributes, ability growth, and resulting attack or defense changes.

sections.title: Refinement types
items: Empress Refinement applies to eligible Mythic or Inherited Ancient equipment.
Longinus Refinement applies to eligible secondary weapons and adds Sharenian Ability.
Genesis Refinement depends on the applicable base equipment and Genesis Weapon Liberation Quest requirement.

sections.title: Access and eligibility
items: Open Refine from Bag > Equipment > Forge or Main Menu > Forge > Refine.
The available refinement type depends on the attributes and rank of the registered base item.
The official requirements table distinguishes weapons, armor, cape, shoulder, and secondary-weapon materials.

sections.title: Materials and sources
items: Empress weapon and armor refinements use Dream Stones associated with Corrupted Empress Cygnus content.
Cape and shoulder refinement uses Life Dream Stones.
Eligible secondary weapons use Rubian from Sharenian's Culvert Elite Dungeon Chaos Mode.

sections.title: Results and inherited properties
items: Base-item options and trade attributes are inherited through refinement.
Physical weapons gain physical attack, magic weapons gain magic attack, and armor gains physical and magic defense.
Refinement effects reset when crafting eligible Necro or Chaos equipment, so the next crafting step must be planned separately.

notes: Structured summary verified from Nexon's official MapleStory M forum guide on 2026-07-27.
prerequisites: Eligible equipment for the selected refinement type
The materials listed for that base item and refinement level
steps: Confirm which refinement type is available.
Review material requirements and inherited properties.
Apply the refinement only after confirming the following Necro or Chaos crafting plan.
